title: AUXCOMM / NIFOG reference extract for GeoSentinel (static reference only)
purpose: Structured factual extract of nationwide interoperability and auxiliary-communications reference frequencies from official U.S. government publications, plus official NWS NWR coverage for Benton County, AR. For a static dashboard reference panel. Not for live RF interception or people tracking. Transmitting on these channels requires the applicable FCC license, NTIA authorization, and/or served-agency authorization.

myNIFOG.license_terms: No open-source or content-reuse license was found on the Play Store listing or the developer site that would allow copying the app's unique content, UI, RF-coverage estimator, or compiled database. The Play Store and privacy page state the app is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by CISA, FEMA, or DHS. Developer copyright notice: © myNIFOG / shipsnever (2026). Privacy policy (effective July 11, 2026): collects no personal data; no accounts, analytics, advertising, or developer-operated server. Optional network use only for user-initiated terrain downloads and place search. App described as free. Unique value-add described (not copied): merged searchable offline NIFOG v2.02 + AUXFOG v1.1, NTIA Irregular Terrain Model coverage estimator, ICS forms, night mode, starring/sharing. This extract does not copy any myNIFOG content.

ctcss_default_hz_nationwide_interop.applies_to: VCALL10, VTAC11-14 (simplex TX and RX), UCALL/UTAC, 8CALL/8TAC, VHF low-band LLAW/LFIRE, and most other non-federal nationwide interoperability channels unless a table says otherwise.

ctcss_vtac_repeater_mobile_tx_hz.applies_to: VTAC33-38 tactical repeater mobile TX tone (RX remains 156.7). Differs from VTAC11-14 simplex, which use 156.7 Hz on TX.

p25_nac.700_mhz_typical: Mobile RX NAC $F7E, Mobile TX NAC $293, default TGID $0001

gmrs_travel_assistance_ctcss_hint_hz.applies_to: GMRS channel 20 (462.6750 / 467.6750) — NIFOG: 'Nationwide Travel’s assistance; if CTCSS is required try 141.3 Hz.'

defaults.encryption_note: Encryption may not be used on the non-federal VHF/UHF/800 nationwide interoperability calling/tactical channels cited in 47 CFR §90.20(i). AES encryption is permitted on 700 MHz interoperability channels except the two nationwide calling channels, with a user-accessible control to disable encryption (47 CFR §90.553). Source: NIFOG channel-table footnotes.

transmitters.also_listed_on: https://www.weather.gov/tsa/weather_radio lists Grove for Benton, AR but at 162.500 MHz (no call sign). The national NWR dataset and the WFO Tulsa table disagree on Grove's frequency; use the national program data (WWH38, 162.525 MHz) and verify against weather.gov/nwr/stations if needed.

source_discrepancy.description: The WFO Tulsa county coverage page lists Benton County AR transmitters as Fayetteville 162.475 and Grove 162.500, and does not list Springdale or call signs. The national NWR station/county dataset used by weather.gov/nwr lists three transmitters covering SAME 005007: WXJ52 Fayetteville 162.475, WNG694 Springdale 162.400, and WWH38 Grove 162.525. Both are official NWS/NOAA sources. The national dataset is the one that includes call signs and is used by the official station listing pages.
